integrity: The cyclic-point law is derived by exact counting, the conditional component law is independently reconstructed from the uniform permutation on cyclic vertices, and the stochastic-regression and covariance results follow analytically. Exact enumeration through n=7 replays the joint law but does not replace the all-n proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the uniform random mapping model.
The conditional cycle-count law given the number of cyclic vertices is prior art; originality is claimed only for the regression and covariance/correlation consequences.
Older bivariate random-mapping generating-function literature may encode equivalent mixed-moment asymptotics.
title: Strong positive regression of component count on cyclic points in a uniform random mapping
